conviction_note: Event confirmed for 2026-10-29 at the usual 14:00 in-session slot; H1 will almost certainly print above the full-year plan (Q1 OP 781m vs FY 900m), but the company held its plan last year with H1 OI already at 104% of it, flagged large promotional spend in H2, and this retail/yutai name sold its +95% Q1 (-2.1% to next close) and barely moved on its last upward revision (+0.45%), so the findings sum to +0.5 while the scaled number is only +0.13 (p_up 55 on abs 1.3): the fundamental read is clearly positive, the reaction function says small.
bar: Company FY3/2027 plan (no sell-side consensus exists: kabuyoho shows consensus '--'): revenue 95,000m, OP 900m, OI 1,000m, NI 750m, unchanged at Q1 (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260731/140120260730503901.pdf). No H1 forecast is published, so print_vs_bar is H1 revenue (~48,100m est. = Q1 24,118 + Q2 ~24,000) vs the plan-implied H1 at last year's 47.1% H1 share (44,760m). 四季報 forecast not reachable (shikiho.toyokeizai.net is a JS shell), so the market's own number is unsourced; findings capped small.

findings.finding: H1 operating profit will exceed the full-year plan (Q1 alone OP 781m = 87% of the 900m FY OP plan, OI 928m = 92.8% of 1,000m), so the H1 print forces a hold-or-raise decision; the company's own record is mixed (raised at H1 in FY3/2024 from OP 700m to 1,000m; held at H1 in FY3/2026 with H1 OI 885m already above the 850m plan, then beat by 54% via a 差異 notice), and the Q1 tanshin explicitly reserved for 'large-scale promotional costs' ahead, so an upward revision is roughly a one-in-three event and a hold is the base case.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: FY3/2024 H1 upward revision (2023-10-27): +0.10% day, +0.45% to next close. FY3/2026 H1 hold with H1 above plan (2025-11-14): +0.25% day, +0.76% to next close. FY3/2027 initial guide cut -16% OP (2026-05-15): -1.23% day, -2.05% to next close.
findings.why_not_priced: The progress rate is public, but nobody covers this name (no consensus on kabuyoho), so whether the plan is raised is not in any number the price can lean on; if a raise were expected the stock would not have drifted from 2,016 to 1,955 into the print at PER 56 on the unrevised EPS of 35. The company's own 5-year average Q1 OI progress is 98.4% (kabutan 2026-07-31), so a high H1 progress is habit, not news, which is why the size is small.
findings.independence: FY3/2026 差異 notice (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260515/140120260515536571.pdf, 2026-05-15) shows the plan-conservatism habit (plan OP 700m, actual 1,077m, no in-year revision); FY3/2024 H1 revision (https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/25940/140120231027573052.pdf). Both are company documents about different years.

findings.finding: Q2 (Jul-Sep) margin should run well above last year's 312m OP: household prices rose 10-30% at shelf from 2026-03-01 deliveries while the ICO composite fell from its historic high (May 256.05, June 248.90 US c/lb) and Q1 operating margin already rose from 1.9% to 3.2%; the offset is the yen above 160 and the flagged promotional spend.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY3/2027 (2026-07-31, OP +95%): -0.74% day, -2.08% to next close. H1 FY3/2026 (2025-11-14): +0.76% to next close. The name sells or ignores quarterly beats.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the price hike and the bean decline are public; what is not is the Q2 number itself, because no monthly sales are published and no analyst models it. If the market had priced a strong Q2 the stock would not be down 3% over the last two weeks into the print.
findings.independence: Price hike: nissyoku/logi-today reporting of the 2025-12-12 announcement (https://www.logi-today.com/889375); margin trend: Q1 tanshin (https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260731/140120260730503901.pdf). Proxy, not a company Q2 number.
